name: Rivalry
metaDescription: Rivalry is a private friend-group competition app for races, tennis, padel, poker and more.
summary: Private friend-group competition across races, tennis, padel, poker and more.

hero.heading: Make friendly competition count.
hero.description: Rivalry gives private groups one place to track results, rankings, stats and the competitions that keep coming back.

section.heading: Competition without the admin.
section.description: Keep the history, standings and bragging rights in one private space.

features.title: Multiple Activities
points: Compete in Race, Tennis, Padel and Poker within the same private group.
Each activity has its own leaderboard, statistics and history.

features.title: Competitive Ratings & Leaderboards
points: Dynamic rating systems for Race and match activities.
Configurable Equal or Individual scoring, Upset Sensitivity and starting ratings.
Track wins, losses, positions and player performance.

features.title: Seasons & Long-Term History
points: Previous seasons remain available alongside all-time stats.
Rating history, result history and player matchup records.

features.title: Advanced Poker Tracking
points: Dedicated Poker sessions with automatic session ending.
Player balances, hand history, statistics and balance-history charts.
Sessions can be renamed, reopened, merged and managed independently.

features.title: Bookings & Shared Payments
points: Track activity bookings, who paid and who attended.
Automatically calculate each player's share using attendance time.
Running balances show who is ahead, behind and suggested to pay next.

features.title: Private Groups & Player Management
points: Secure join codes with optional join-request approval.
Owners, configurable Admin permissions and member management.
Profiles can be claimed, archived, restored and preserved in historical results.

features.title: Smart Notifications
points: Configurable notifications for results, bookings, group activity and other events.
In-app notification inbox with direct links to relevant content.
